summary.text: On Dominaria, the Ur-Dragon brushes past and spawns the elder dragons, whose Elder Dragon War leaves only a few dragons alive.
Nicol Bolas manipulates the dragon clans against each other until, in the last clash on Jamuraa, his spark ignites in rage and envy and he planeswalks away, ending the war.
Meanwhile Geyadrone Dihada has Dakkon forge the Blackblade, then triggers his spark and absorbs his soul into it.
